---
title: "MA Income"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(dplyr)

# Set your Census API key

# Load median income for Massachusetts from the American Community Survey (ACS)
ma_income_tracts <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  variables = "B19013_001",  # Median household income
  state = "MA",
  year = 2022,
  survey = "acs5",
  geometry = FALSE           # No map shapes, just the data
)
ggplot(ma_income_tracts, aes(x = estimate)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5000, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Median Household Income by Census Tract (MA, 2022)",
    x = "Median Household Income (USD)",
    y = "Number of Census Tracts"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
